# situation: a step prints the names of the labels of the pull request with
#   github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name in the text of run.
# reason: the value of the ${{ }} is an array, and GitHub writes the text
#   Array in place of the names: the step prints labels=Array.
on: workflow_call
permissions: {contents: read}
jobs:
  labels:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - run: echo "labels=${{ github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name }}"
